title: Myne theme metadata
description: Schema for themes/<slug>/meta.json. Human-readable metadata lives here, NOT in theme.json (the value allowlist rejects human strings inside the palette).

name.description: Human-facing theme name shown in the gallery.

author.description: Attribution — for an ORIGINAL theme, the creator; for a PORT, the upstream scheme's author. This is how credit appears in the gallery.

description.description: One or two sentences describing the theme.

license.description: SPDX id. CC-BY-4.0 is the DEFAULT for original contributions; a faithful PORT keeps its upstream license (usually MIT). If a port's license isn't listed, add it in the same PR.

upstream.description: For a PORT: the URL of the original color scheme (required to license it under anything other than CC-BY-4.0).

port_by.description: Optional — who adapted the upstream scheme to Myne's tokens (distinct from the original `author`).

homepage.description: Optional URL for the author or the theme's source.
